sentences.text:
Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of
 India for issuance of Writ of Mandamus, forbearing the second
 respondent from appointing / promoting any person as Designated
 Officer under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 without
 considering the petitioner (Food Inspector / Food Safety Officer) for 
 post of Designated Officer in terms of Section 36 and Rule 2.1.2 of th
Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the Food Safety and
 Standards Rules, 2011.

 Additional Government Pleader.

When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned counsel appearing for the writ petitioner submitted that the relief sought for in this Writ Petition has become infructuous and he has also made an endorsement to that effect.
2.In view of the endorsement so made, the Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
